verdict.rationale: Wrike's own materials claim a library of more than 100 industry-standard pre-built templates for rapid deployment, which directly matches jumpstarting new work from templates. The evidence is a single marketing line: it does not say these are project templates or show how a project manager would start a project from one. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating a new project from a template, details of template contents and customization, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can jumpstart a new project using pre-built templates

citations.quote: Library of 100+ industry-standard templates for rapid deployment
